verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Tailscale issues API keys, and community notes they expire after 60 days. It also offers infrastructure-as-code automation and ephemeral, authenticated connections for non-human workloads like GitHub runners, which hints at machine credentials. Nothing shows that those credentials can be scoped to least privilege. Missing for 10: documented scoped or least-privilege API key or OAuth permission scopes, per-agent credential issuance docs, any first-party documentation of the API credential model, and independent corroboration.
